# Tailwind Theme Customizer Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Tailwind CSS

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for Tailwind Theme Customizer operations using Tailwind CSS technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for Tailwind CSS within Frontend development.

## When to Use

- When customizing Tailwind theme for brand design system
- When implementing dark mode with Tailwind CSS
- When extending Tailwind configuration with custom design tokens
- When Tailwind CSS-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for Tailwind CSS technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade Tailwind CSS implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Extend theme with custom colors and spacing scales
- Configure typography with custom font families and sizes
- Implement dark mode with class or media strategy
- Create custom design tokens mapped to Tailwind config
- Set up CSS custom properties for dynamic theming

## Procedure

1. Analyze brand design system requirements
2. Map design tokens to Tailwind theme extensions
3. Configure tailwind.config with custom theme
4. Implement dark mode strategy
5. Set up CSS custom properties for runtime theming
6. Test theme consistency across components

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not override Tailwind defaults without documenting the change
- Verify theme extension syntax for the target Tailwind version
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Theme values maintain visual consistency
- Dark mode covers all themed components
- Custom properties fallback gracefully
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow Tailwind CSS community best practices
